status_load_world_first: Load a world (.wld) to see this point on the map.
status_research_all_applied: Full research applied ({0} items) - press Save to keep it.
status_nothing_to_move: Nothing to move: the inventory is empty or the selected storage has no free slot.
status_moved_singular: Moved {0} item to the selected storage - press Save to keep it.
status_moved_plural: Moved {0} items to the selected storage - press Save to keep it.
status_inventory_full: The inventory is full - there's no free slot to place it with a double click.
status_no_free_buff_slot: There's no free buff slot to place it with a double click.
status_set_added_to: Set added to {0}: {1} - press Save to keep it.
status_set_loaded_into: Set loaded into {0}: {1} - press Save to keep it.
status_buff_set_added_to: Buff set added to {0}: {1} - press Save to keep it.
status_buff_set_loaded_into: Buff set loaded into {0}: {1} - press Save to keep it.
error_buff_duplicate: '{0}' is already applied in another slot - Terraria doesn't allow two instances of the same buff.
status_saved_backup: Saved to the file - backup at {0}.bak
summary_of_total_capped_map_all: {0:N0} of {1:N0} {2}(s) (capped at 1000 in the list - the map marks them ALL)
warning_covers_map_fraction: Warning: covers {0} of the map, may not be legible at a glance.
scan_no_worlds_folder: No real Terraria worlds folder found (vanilla or tModLoader).
whatsnew_intro_2: - new items, fixes, and more. To see what changed in Terrakeep itself, go to
home_description_part1: Terraria character editor - vanilla and Calamity Mod (tModLoader) at the same time, from the same file. Native Windows app, lightweight and instant to start. Load a
home_description_part3: if it has one) and edit inventory, per-loadout equipment, buffs, research, pets/mounts, appearance and more - Calamity items are detected and edited just like vanilla ones, marked in
home_card_library_desc: Search thousands of vanilla and Calamity items by name and place them directly into any slot.
home_card_builds_desc: Recommended gear by class and game stage (vanilla and Calamity), with one-click auto-equip.
home_card_exploration_desc: Load a .wld world and browse its full map: pan, zoom and town NPCs with their location.
home_card_whatsnew_desc: What changed in each version of the GAME and Calamity Mod - new items, fixes, and more.
home_card_about_desc: What changed in Terrakeep itself, installed version and credits.
tt_save_inventory_json: Saves the ENTIRE Inventory to a real .json file, to bring it to another character
tt_load_inventory_replace: Replaces the ENTIRE Inventory with a .json set saved before
tt_add_inventory_fill: Fills only the free slots of the Inventory with a .json set saved before
tt_move_all_storage_tab: Moves the entire Inventory to the storage selected in the Storage tab (Piggy Bank/Safe/Forge/Void Vault) - whatever doesn't fit stays where it is
tt_sort_by_id: Sorts items by Id, packed at the start
tt_move_all_storage_right: Moves the entire Inventory to the storage selected on the right - whatever doesn't fit stays where it is
tt_save_storage_json: Saves this ENTIRE storage to a real .json file, to bring it to another character
tt_load_storage_replace: Replaces this ENTIRE storage with a .json set saved before
tt_add_storage_fill: Fills only the free slots of this storage with a .json set saved before
tt_empty_storage: Empties all slots of this storage
tt_ctrlf_library: Ctrl+F jumps here and focuses the search box (unless Buffs is the active tab)
library_pick_item_placeholder: Choose (or drag) an item to place it in the selected slot...
tt_search_grammar_full: Comma = several searches at once, space = all words at once, #123 = by id, #100-200 = by id range, .text = search in the description
tt_save_buffs_json: Saves ALL buffs to a real .json file, to bring them to another character
tt_load_buffs_replace: Replaces ALL buffs with a .json set saved before
tt_add_buffs_fill: Fills only the free Buff slots with a .json set saved before (without duplicating already-active buffs)
tt_ctrlf_buff_library: Ctrl+F jumps here and focuses the search box (if Buffs is the active tab)
buff_library_pick_placeholder: Choose (or drag) a buff to place it in the selected slot...
research_not_journey_mode: This character is not in Journey Mode - Research only actually unlocks recipes in a game of that mode.
tt_remove_all_research: Removes ALL of the character's real research - the real equivalent of 'Remove All' from the original Terrasavr
tt_search_grammar_research: Comma = several searches at once, space = all words at once, #123 = by id, #100-200 = by id range (searches only among what's already researched)
tt_remove_folder_research: Removes the real research for EVERYTHING in this folder
tt_research_count: Real research count - editable by hand, 0 = not researched
tt_appearance_preview: Real full-body preview (real game sprites, arms and torso included, real armor/vanity worn) - no item in hand or animation, just the idle pose. Doesn't apply the hair dye's visual effect (a special shader this preview doesn't reproduce), only its base hair color.
tt_hex_color: Hex color code (e.g. #FF0000) - type one and click outside the field to apply it
spawn_points_intro: World-saved spawn points. "Id" is an internal world identifier, not readable text - you usually won't need to touch it.
tt_world_internal_id: Internal world identifier, not readable text - you usually won't need to touch it
tt_goto_map_spawn: Go to Exploration and center the map on this spawn point
unlocks_intro: Permanent unlocks and activations for the character.
version_warning_1_3_0: This character is from a version earlier than 1.3.0 (145) - this change won't be saved.
version_warning_1_4_0_5: This character is from a version earlier than 1.4.0.5 (230) - this change won't be saved.
version_warning_1_4_4_0: This character is from a version earlier than 1.4.4.0 (269) - this change won't be saved.
flag_dd2_event: Second Dimensional Defense event completed (can use summons)
version_warning_1_3_4: This character is from a version earlier than 1.3.4 (184) - this change won't be saved.
version_warning_below_253: This character is from a version too old (below 253, after 1.4.3.0) - this change won't be saved.
version_warning_change: Careful: changing the version changes which fields the save reads/writes. A value that doesn't match the character's real content can produce a file that neither this app nor the game can read back correctly.
explore_readonly_tooltip: This viewer only reads the world (the same world Terraria itself loads) - it doesn't place or remove blocks. One real exception, explicitly requested: world difficulty, editable in 'This world' with an automatic backup
explore_export_png_tooltip: Saves the map as a PNG image - includes ore highlights if any are active
explore_load_prompt: Load a .wld world to see its full map
explore_search_subtitle: Only what exists in this world
explore_collapse_sidebar: Collapse the sidebar (leaves the map full screen)
explore_save_difficulty_tooltip: Writes the new mode directly to the world's .wld file (creates an automatic .bak backup first) - the only real write action in the whole Exploration viewer
explore_search_grammar: In 'All': commas = OR, spaces = AND, #123 or #100-200 by id (searches the whole world). In the other categories: filters the list below by name or id.
explore_zoom_on_navigate: Zoom in when jumping to a result
explore_zoom_on_navigate_tooltip: When jumping to a result, besides centering it, applies a working zoom level (not just panning)
explore_no_match_hint: Try fewer words, or the id: #123
explore_goto_position: Go to its position on the map
explore_sort_by_depth_tooltip: Also sorts by depth - the most hidden first
explore_mark_ores_tooltip: Highlights ALL positions on the map (no cap) and lists the veins (grouped, up to 1000)
explore_mark_objects_tooltip: Highlights ALL positions on the map (no cap) and lists the groups (grouped, up to 1000)
settings_extra_folders_1: Extra folders (besides the ones Terrakeep already detects on its own in
settings_extra_folders_2: ) and how many backups to keep per character.
settings_backup_cap_tooltip: How many rotating backups to keep per character ('Save history') - the oldest ones above this number get purged automatically
settings_pin_window_label: Always start with the window's current size and position
settings_pin_window_tooltip: Saves this window's size and position right now - Terrakeep will always start this way until you uncheck it
about_changelog_1: This is the changelog of the
about_changelog_2: (Terrakeep) itself - what was added and fixed, version by version. For the game/Calamity changelog, go to «What's New».
tt_already_have_item: You already have this item (in some container of the loaded character)
tt_auto_equip: Replaces the armor and accessories worn in the selected loadout WITHOUT CONFIRMATION (weapons are placed in the first free Inventory slot, without overwriting anything) - don't save if you weren't sure
tt_duration_min_2x: 2x the minimum duration - the only real ramp precedent in the game (Lucky Potion)
tt_duration_max: Real maximum duration allowed by Terrasavr
tt_library_click_place: Click: places it in the slot selected in Edit. Double click: in the first free Inventory slot.
tt_library_no_slot_selected: No slot selected - pick one first (click any slot) to place with a single click, or double-click right here to go straight to the first free Inventory slot.
tt_or_drag_card: Or drag the card to any slot.
tt_buff_library_click_place: Click: places it in the slot selected in Buffs. Double click: in the first free slot.
tt_buff_library_no_slot_selected: No slot selected - pick one first (click any Buff slot) to place with a single click, or double-click right here to go straight to the first free slot.
tt_restore_last_backup: Restores the LAST real save (the .bak left by every Save) - to pick an earlier point, see 'Save history'
tt_current_character: This is the character currently loaded
tt_no_mods_no_tplr: No mods: this character has no .tplr file alongside it
tt_has_calamity_content: Has real Calamity items or buffs saved
tt_current_world: This is the world currently loaded
tt_check_for_bulk_action: Check it for a bulk action (see the buttons above)
tt_goto_map_toggle_contents: Go to this position on the map and show/hide its contents
tt_undo_last_save: Restores the character exactly as it was BEFORE the last real 'Save' (uses the .bak copy)
tt_name_mismatch: The character's name doesn't match the file name
tt_search_grammar_basic: Comma = several searches at once, space = all words at once, #123 = by id, #100-200 = by id range
